posts.body:
So, it looks to me like you're using the wrong flag in your sleep mechanic.
<Self> CarrotSeeds should be <Self> Carrots Planted. I hope it's something this simple!
Edit: disregard, I misread this.
However, I feel like you should have a separate variable for the growth of the carrots than the seeds themselves. Looking at my own system with multiple crops (that I'm still learning how it works, I got the farming system template to learn from from a dev on itch called CazWolf or Caz), I have a separate variable for when crops grow. But mine looks a bit more complex than yours.
But I'm going to leave it to those who know a bit more than I do, because I already flubbed up.

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
There's several problems, I think.
You don't need self-switches B, C and D. You can put pages 3,4, and 5 to action button instead of parallel (remove their contents too). Also, do you really need to go with self-switch A from an empty pot page to another empty pot page? I suggested to use self-switch A when you plant the seeds.
Your scripts are also wrong. Read carefully what each spot should contain. And replace the +X in my example with +1
If you want to set the value back to 0, you don't need the get-script in that case inside it (you seem to have made your own modifications with '=' in some spots).
Your sleep-event seems to control it's own self variable. You need to control the self variables of the crop events (I gave you an example of the loop in the post above).
EDIT: Also, inside the event you can just use the control variables to affect the self variables, instead of the scripts.

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
Hmmm, I tested the loop script and it seems to be working for me.
Are the crops in map id 1? That's what you're affecting right now in your scripts.

posts.body:
Ok, if you're using some spawner plugin, I don't know how they interact with them. But VS Events and Move has their own spawner, I assume they would work with that.
Anyway, if you're spawning them to Map 2, you should try affecting them there right?

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
It seems to work for me. Are you targeting the ids of your spawned events?
Like when you spawn an event you can get it's id with:
$gameMap.lastSpawnedEventID()
Store those and loop through them to target the spawned events.
You can test it without the loop. Just use that setSelfVariable stuff and replace the event id with the above script.
